name: Hugo
source:
A vampire. Unlike his brothers and sisters, Hugo has no interest in sucking blood, resulting in him having a weak body.

[Summarized from [url=http://breadmasterlee.wordpress.com/2009/06/07/otome-game-review-love-drops/]Hinano's review[/url].]
